top_choice_rationale: Targeted protein degradation (Crews, Deshaies, Handa) is a game-changer: induced proximity to a ubiquitin ligase is a new mode of small-molecule action, backed by ternary-complex and cereblon-ligand structures and by approved cereblon-directed drugs. The citation names both strands (degrader design and cereblon as the target of glue degraders) and claims a concept, not universal degradability. Open concerns are that no PROTAC is approved and that Sakamoto and Ciulli have priority claims. P002 (ionizable lipid nanoparticles) follows, since its decisive-step attribution is still unsettled. P003 (Pd C-N coupling) has clean credit but is close to an extension of an already recognized logic. A prize is better than none.
